answer: To prevent Sybil proliferation, an agent network anchors identity validation to verifiable spatial beacon latency measurements verified along a physical jetty. Much like pruning a fruit orchard where total harvest is bounded by physical land rather than virtual tree tags, protocol influence requires burning unique delay-attestation proofs generated by scarce hardware modules. Even if an adversary spawns an ocean of synthetic agents, each identity independently incurs the non-amortizable capital expense of dedicated sensor hardware, preventing profitable multi-identity manipulation.
